description: confirm() decrements stock on both DO and D1 helper, violating V8 invariant that stock is unchanged under confirm() (only reserved->sold shift). Causes available = stock - reserved - sold drift and phantom oversell.
recommended_fix: In variant-inventory-do.ts:186-197 confirm action delete `this.stock -= qty;`. In inventory.ts:362-370 delete `quantity = quantity - ?1,` line. Keep reserved_quantity decrement.

master_plan_ref: Section 0 (Part-1:87), Section 11.5 step 7 (Part-1:1536), Guardrail #46, D-40, D-42
description: Settled-money ledger layer entirely missing. payment_transactions table absent; payment_events dedups on UNIQUE(invoice_id, event_type, status) NOT V8's UNIQUE(provider, provider_event_id). applyPaymentVerified mints fresh crypto.randomUUID() for payment_events.id so INSERT OR IGNORE can never suppress a replay by PK.
recommended_fix: Land V8 migrations (renumbered 0048+) adding payment_events.{provider,provider_event_id} + UNIQUE(provider,provider_event_id); create payment_transactions + UNIQUE(payment_event_id,direction); rewrite applyPaymentVerified to use stable provider event id and write ledger row keyed by it; treat unique violation as no-op replay.

description: InvoiceCounterDO.nextInvoiceNumber() has zero call sites. invoices.ts:280 generateReceiptNoWithRetry uses D1 SELECT MAX+1 anti-pattern that V8 15.5 forbids. UNIQUE(receipt_no) + retry catches collisions only after the fact, producing gapped serials - Mushak VAT audit liability.
recommended_fix: Replace generateReceiptNoWithRetry with env.INVOICE_COUNTER_DO.idFromName('invoice-counter:{YYYYMMDD}').get() -> nextInvoiceNumber(). On D1 invoice-write failure record serial as serial_burned in invoice_audit (never reuse).

description: Hourly VariantInventoryDO->R2 JSONL snapshot, restoreFromSnapshot() DO method, and DR_RESTORE_ENABLED env gate all absent. Weekly restore drill only counts D1 rows - cannot assert DO/D1 stock parity. Restoring D1 leaves every DO holding pre-restore counters.
recommended_fix: Add hourly cron writing {variant_id,stock,reserved,sold,snapshot_id,captured_at} to R2 backups/do/...; add restoreFromSnapshot() to VariantInventoryDO (gated by DR_RESTORE_ENABLED); extend drill to assert per-variant DO.reserved == SUM(active stock_reservations).

description: 7-year append-only audit_log holds raw customer identifiers (phone/email/order_id with PII link). No customer_ref column. AUDIT_CUSTOMER_REF_SALT secret absent. No trg_audit_log_no_update/no_delete triggers. Section 28.3 deletion right is unsatisfiable.
recommended_fix: Add customer_ref column + AUDIT_CUSTOMER_REF_SALT secret; in prepareAuditLogInsert hash customer identifier into customer_ref, store only order_id + hash. Add append-only triggers. Mark salt NEVER-rotated.

description: RESERVATION_TTL_MINUTES = 10. V8 mandates 60 minutes - strictly greater than 30-min payment window + 15-min reconciliation. Code TTL shorter than payment window itself; cleanup cron can release reservations mid-payment.
recommended_fix: export const RESERVATION_TTL_MINUTES = 60; Add Section 37.0 #5 reservation-window-outlasts-payment test asserting reservation_expires_at > payment_window + reconcile_window.

description: stock_reservations has no checkout_id column; uses retired idx_stock_reservations_order_active name only; missing both V8 partial uniques (idx_stock_res_order_variant_active, idx_stock_res_checkout_variant_active). Per-order reservation races not prevented at DB layer.
recommended_fix: Add migration (0048+) dropping retired index, adding checkout_id column, creating both partials with V8 names. Update D-23 in audit-drift.ts to reject retired name.

description: BudgetCounterDO object ID format is {provider}:{YYYY-MM-DD} not V8-mandated budget:{provider}. New object per provider per day - monthly caps cannot be enforced. daily/monthly soft_alert/hard_block table partially defeated.
recommended_fix: Replace all four idFromName sites with env.AI_BUDGET.idFromName(`budget:${provider}`); consolidate daily + monthly counters inside single object.

description: State machine is V7 - missing created/confirmed/processing states. Auto-confirm unreachable; confirmReservationsForOrder invoked from staff_confirmed instead of canonical entry. confirm.ts (K-37) bypasses canTransition.
recommended_fix: Rebuild state machine per V8 spec; migrate existing orders.status values to V8 vocabulary in renumbered migration.

description: VAT computed from VAT_RATE_PERCENT env var at 4 runtime sites. V8 retires this env var; rate must come from D1 tax_rates. tax_rates table absent from all migrations. audit-drift.ts D-19 inverts the rule (passes when env var present).
recommended_fix: Create tax_rates table + seed; replace 4 call sites with D1 lookup; flip D-19 to reject VAT_RATE_PERCENT.

description: Webhook IPN API-key check fail-open: requires both ipnKey header AND env var truthy before comparing. Omitting header bypasses check entirely.
recommended_fix: if (!env.UDDOKTAPAY_API_KEY) return 500; if (!ipnKey || !timingSafeEqualHex(ipnKey, env.UDDOKTAPAY_API_KEY)) return 401;

description: readWebhookSignature accepts X-UddoktaPay-Signature || X-Signature || Signature. Generic Signature/X-Signature settable by intermediate proxies or attacker clients.
recommended_fix: Closed list: X-UddoktaPay-Signature only.

description: Client Idempotency-Key header becomes payments.id PK verbatim. No format validation, no HMAC, no server prefix. Client can choose arbitrary string including one colliding with another order's payment id.
recommended_fix: Always generate PK server-side: const paymentId = crypto.randomUUID(); Use Idempotency-Key only as separate column with UNIQUE(order_id, idempotency_key).

description: GET /api/payments/status/[id] has no auth and no ownership check. Any caller knowing/guessing payments.id (made attacker-chosen by K-03) gets row - order_id, invoice_id, amount_paisa, status.
recommended_fix: Require phone-OTP bearer token; join payments->orders and verify token phone matches orders.customer_phone.

description: void work; no-retry fallback path. When cfContext.waitUntil absent, processPaymentWebhookMessage promise detached with no .catch. Errors swallowed silently; 200 already returned.
recommended_fix: Always await work or use ctx.waitUntil with explicit .catch; queue retry on failure.

description: Event-id fallback to sha256(rawBody). Body tweak (whitespace/reorder) produces different hash, bypassing dedup.
recommended_fix: Reject events without stable provider_event_id; never use body-hash as id.

description: metadata.order_id mismatch check conditional on metadata being present. If gateway omits metadata or returns non-string, guard skipped.
recommended_fix: Make check unconditional: require metadata.order_id presence; reject on mismatch or absence.

description: PARTIAL-REFUTE: reservation is TTL-bounded (10 min per INV-6) + swept every 5 min - not indefinite. Real defect reassigned to INV-6 (TTL too short). Secondary asymmetry: checkout.ts:401-403 treats payment-create failure as non-fatal (keeps order+reservation) vs buy-now/submit.ts:367-375 cancels.
recommended_fix: Fix INV-6 first. Align checkout and buy-now failure handling on payment create.

description: Order INSERTed without advance_paisa; separate UPDATE sets it after. Race window between statements - payment-create can read advance_paisa=0.
recommended_fix: Add advance_paisa, balance_paisa to INSERT column list in insertReservedOrderWithRetry; remove separate UPDATE.

description: coupon-rate-limit.ts dead code (zero callers). validate-coupon.ts has no rate limit - brute-force coupon codes possible.
recommended_fix: Wire checkCouponRateLimit/recordCouponFailure into validate-coupon.ts by IP + cart sid.

description: Trusts client subtotalPaisa for min-order check and discount calc. Leaks coupon params (discountType, discountAmountPaisa, discountPercent) in response.
recommended_fix: Recompute subtotal server-side from cart contents; return only discountPaisa.

description: body.variant_id overrides session.variant_id. Mitigated by product-scope check at :152-158 (variant must belong to session.productId).
recommended_fix: Ignore body.variant_id entirely; use session.variant_id only.

description: redirectUrl/cancelUrl built from raw context.request.headers.get('Origin') with no validation. Open redirect -> phishing.
recommended_fix: Validate Origin against own-origins allowlist; fall back to env.PUBLIC_SITE_URL.

description: Empty binding secret produces deterministic sha256(''). Verification matches any empty secret. D1 fallback matches bindingHash IS NULL.
recommended_fix: Reject empty bindingSecret at create; reject bindingHash === sha256('') at verify; require server-generated random secret returned to client.

description: Fraud check fail-opens on circuit-open/timeout. Returns score 50 -> review -> order allowed (only 'blocked' prevents order).
recommended_fix: Policy decision: either block on circuit-open or require manual approval. Document the choice. Currently the comment at fraud.ts:10 documents fail-open as intended - acceptable only if Owner signs off.

description: Fraud override has step-up auth but no cooldown/rate-limit. Owner with valid step-up can override unlimited orders back-to-back.
recommended_fix: Add per-actor cooldown + rate-limit; alert above threshold.

description: COD address velocity weak normalization. Only toLowerCase().trim(). No whitespace collapse/punctuation strip/postal canonicalization. Trivial evasion.
recommended_fix: Normalize addresses: collapse whitespace, strip punctuation, canonicalize postal code before velocity query.

description: session_id accepted from request body, overrides zb_cart_sid cookie. Attacker can probe/replay arbitrary session IDs.
recommended_fix: Ignore body.session_id; use cookie only (matches buy-now/submit.ts:49-53 pattern).

description: Turnstile bypassable via any body.totp_code. Condition `env.TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY && !body.totp_code` skips entire Turnstile block regardless of whether account has TOTP.
recommended_fix: Decouple: Turnstile unconditional when secret set; validate TOTP independently.

description: Three divergent KV blacklist key prefixes (session-blacklist:, session:blacklist:, staff-session:). requireAuth/getCurrentStaffUser never call isSessionRevoked - blacklist KV written but not consulted on auth path. Revocation falls back to D1 staff_sessions.is_revoked only.
recommended_fix: Pick one prefix; call isSessionRevoked in getCurrentStaffUser; or delete the KV layer.

description: Password reset tokens not invalidated account-wide on use. Only the single presented token marked used. Other unexpired tokens for same staff_id remain valid.
recommended_fix: On use: UPDATE password_reset_tokens SET used_at = ?, revoked_at = ? WHERE staff_id = ? AND id <> ?.

description: TOTP verify trusts client body.secret. verifyTotpCode(body.secret, body.code) and storeStaffTotpSecret(user.id, body.secret). Attacker on stolen session enrolls own TOTP -> persistent ATO.
recommended_fix: Store server-generated pending secret at setup (D1 otp_secrets.pending_secret_cipher); verify against that; ignore body.secret.

description: TOTP disable requires only requireAuth + role, no step-up. Stolen cookie disables 2FA.
recommended_fix: Call requireRecentStaffSession before clearStaffTotpSecret.

description: 11 sensitive endpoints lack requireRecentStaffSession: returns/[id]/approve.ts:21, invoices/[id]/void.ts:22, api-keys/index.ts:45/120, roles/index.ts:51, roles/[id].ts:45/108, settings.ts:28, cache/purge.ts:12, inventory/adjust.ts:12, totp/disable.ts:10. Step-up is opt-in per-handler; no central registry.
recommended_fix: Call requireRecentStaffSession in each; introduce SENSITIVE_ROUTES registry consumed by middleware.

description: PBKDF2 iterations = 100,000. OWASP recommends >=600,000 for PBKDF2-SHA256. ~6x below.
recommended_fix: >=600,000 iterations with eager migration of legacy hashes on next login.

description: Login rate limiter fails OPEN when SESSION KV missing. If binding dropped/misconfigured at deploy, brute-force protection silently disappears.
recommended_fix: Fail CLOSED: return { ok: false, retryAfterSeconds: 30 } when KV missing.

description: X-Forwarded-For trusted as fallback for client IP at 3 sites. CF-Connecting-IP is platform-set; XFF is client-spoofable. Drives api-keys IP allowlist + rate-limit.
recommended_fix: Use CF-Connecting-IP only; remove XFF fallback.

description: TOTP no replay protection (no used_codes/last_used_counter). Same 6-digit code accepted repeatedly within +-1 window (~90s). No real backup codes - backup_codes_hash always literal 'none'.
recommended_fix: Add used_codes table or last_used_counter column; implement backup code generation + consumption.

description: Non-constant-time comparisons on secrets/hashes/signatures at: csrf.ts:31, phone-verification.ts:161-162 (OTP hash) + 217-218 (HMAC sig), audit.ts:121/139 (chain hashes), maintenance/backup.ts:330 (backup sig), login.ts:122 (legacy hash), step-up.ts:54 (legacy hash).
recommended_fix: Route all secret/hash/sig compares through timingSafeEqualHex from security.ts.

description: PII_KEYS missing nid, national_id, passport, postal_code, full_name, name, dob, date_of_birth. PII fields with these keys pass through unredacted.
recommended_fix: Add the 8 missing keys to PII_KEYS set.

description: verifyAuditChain windowed: LIMIT 1000 default, LIMIT 10000 scheduled. On 7-year append-only log this is tiny fraction - chain verification not exhaustive. Rows beyond limit never checked.
recommended_fix: Stream full chain or anchor to checkpoint; never LIMIT.

description: Alias for INV-3 - InvoiceCounterDO dead code, racy D1 read-modify-write.
recommended_fix: See INV-3.

description: Returns approve restocks BEFORE refund; not reversed on refund failure. Refund failure paths revert return_requests to pending but do NOT reverse the restock. Stock inflated; customer not refunded.
recommended_fix: Refund FIRST then restock; on refund failure do not restock; if restock already done, reverse it via doAdjustStock(-qty).

description: body.mock === true settable from request body in production. No env guard. Staff with orders.ship can create mock shipment, fake tracking number, flip order to shipped.
recommended_fix: Reject body.mock in production; gate mock by env only.

description: No courier webhook signature verification (no /api/courier/[provider]/webhook route exists at all). When inbound courier webhooks are added in future, they would have no HMAC.
recommended_fix: Add /api/courier/[provider]/webhook with HMAC + replay guard from day one.

description: CSRF key rotation is no-op placeholder. File header self-documents as placeholder. Only timestamp advances; no key generated; no CSRF_SIGNING_KEY/CSRF_SIGNING_KEY_PREV mutated.
recommended_fix: Implement: generate new key, store old as _PREV, update current, log rotation in audit_log.

description: confirm.ts bypasses canTransition order state machine. Uses ad-hoc status string comparisons instead. Compare with pack/ship/deliver which all call canTransition.
recommended_fix: Import canTransition; replace ad-hoc ladders with canTransition calls.

description: No cancel/refund API route for orders. cancelled from payment_verified triggers restock+refund_full via effects but no manual cancel route exists.
recommended_fix: Add /api/staff/orders/[id]/cancel and /refund routes with step-up + state machine checks.

description: Abandoned-cart recovery URL leaks session_id in query string. Query strings logged by proxies/CDNs, appear in Referer to third-party resources, persist in browser history. Combined with K-18 (checkout accepts body session_id) anyone with URL can resume session.
recommended_fix: Use HMAC-signed opaque recovery token resolved server-side; never put session_id in URL.

description: Cart session ID unsigned raw UUID (no HMAC). Cookie SameSite=Lax (not Strict). Attacker can forge any zb_cart_sid to assume another guest cart. doMergeCart dead code - zero callers.
recommended_fix: Sign sid with HMAC; SameSite=Strict; either call doMergeCart on guest login or delete the dead code.

description: Fake sequential JS. Mock DB factory .run() hardcoded to {changes:1}. Concurrency test uses plain JS closure counters (successes++) - cannot fail by construction. Tests nothing about SQL atomicity.
recommended_fix: Rewrite against real D1 + miniflare invoking real reserveVariants.

description: 3 *-dlq declared, 0 consumers. order-emails/image-processing/cart-activity have no DLQ at all. DLQ messages accumulate indefinitely; exhausted-retry messages on the 3 queues silently dropped.
recommended_fix: Add DLQ consumers + drainers + alerts for all 3 DLQs; add DLQs for the 3 queues missing them.

description: Order email consumer not idempotent on retry. No email_log insert on success path before ack; no dedup check at top. Worker dies after send before ack -> redelivery -> second email.
recommended_fix: Insert email_log with status='sent' before ack; dedup on (order_id, email_type) at top.

description: doAdjustStock D1 fallback non-atomic (SELECT-then-UPDATE). SELECT standalone outside transaction. Negativity guard + audit values derive from stale read. Two concurrent calls can both pass guard. (Final UPDATE arithmetic is atomic; corruption is in the guard + audit values.)
recommended_fix: Single atomic UPDATE ... WHERE quantity >= abs(delta) with RETURNING prev_quantity, new_quantity for audit.

description: Hand-rolled Map. Pure in-memory Record arithmetic. No D1/miniflare/SQL/DO. Asserts a JS ternary.
recommended_fix: Rewrite against real SQL + DO.

description: 8 Durable Objects declared, V8 mandates 7. WafRules is extra - not in V8 catalog. Unspecified DOs are DR + maintenance liability.
recommended_fix: Owner decision: amend V8 6.6 + add Guardrail, or remove WafRules.

description: 6 of 8 DOs use raw unprefixed object IDs. V8 specifies variant:{id}, cart:{id}, buy:{id}, idem:{scope}:{id}, budget:{provider}, provider:{name} prefixes. Flat namespace -> cross-type collision risk. Fixing later requires data migration across object space.
recommended_fix: Add prefixes; alias old IDs to new for transition period via new migration tag.

description: audit-drift.ts asserts 44 checks, V8 mandates 46. D-45 and D-46 absent. Merge gate enforces V7 not V8.
recommended_fix: Add D-45 and D-46 checks per Section 38.2; bump assertion to 46.

description: D-19 and D-23 inverted. D-19 passes when VAT_RATE_PERCENT present (V8 retires it). D-23 passes when retired idx_stock_reservations_order_active present (V8 retires it). Green run gives false confidence.
recommended_fix: Flip both: D-19 rejects VAT_RATE_PERCENT; D-23 rejects retired index name. Land ADR-0001 option C.

description: Drift codes D-45 (COD ceiling/velocity source) and D-46 (variants compatibility view) absent entirely from check list.
recommended_fix: Add D-45 (rg MAX_COD_VALUE_PAISA etc -> must come from site_settings) and D-46 (rg FROM variants -> 0 hits).

description: KV session-cache read dead code. sessionKV.get(...) neither awaited nor assigned - result discarded. Auth always falls through to D1 query. KV cache write fire-and-forget with .catch(() => {}).
recommended_fix: Either await and use value, or remove dead read.

description: Three divergent KV revocation key prefixes: session-blacklist:, session:blacklist:, staff-session:. Compounded by K-20 (blacklist not read on auth path).
recommended_fix: Pick one prefix; call isSessionRevoked in getCurrentStaffUser; or delete KV layer.

description: super_admin short-circuits all permission checks (can() returns true for everything). Compromised super_admin session has unrestricted access including destructive platform perms.
recommended_fix: Keep super_admin broad but exclude destructive platform perms (or require two-person rule).

description: getRequiredStaffPermission falls through to orders.update/orders.view for unmapped paths. New sensitive route forgetting to register defaults to too-loose permission. Also p.includes('/totp/') returns null (no permission) for ALL TOTP routes incl disable.
recommended_fix: Default-deny: unmapped paths return null for GET and sentinel __UNMAPPED__ that fails-closed for mutations.

description: Step-up TTL 10 min (plan target <=5 min, scoped). Step-up also opt-in per-handler - no central sensitive-route registry, so coverage patchy (K-24).
recommended_fix: Reduce TTL to 5 min; introduce SENSITIVE_ROUTES registry consumed by middleware.

description: /api/me/delete does not anonymize audit_log. Batch touches only orders and cart_activity. Combined with INV-5 (raw PII in audit_log), Section 28.3 deletion-right promise unsatisfiable.
recommended_fix: Land INV-5 first (customer_ref HMAC); then /api/me/delete is sufficient by construction.

description: /api/me/delete runs immediately, not in 30-day window. Plan states 30-day processing window. No fraud/chargeback cool-down.
recommended_fix: Amend plan to allow immediate anonymization, or queue anonymization for 30 days out.

description: CSP style-src 'unsafe-inline' shipped in production (both public and staff). Plan forbids 'unsafe-inline'. script-src is correct (nonce + strict-dynamic + hashes) but style injection remains.
recommended_fix: Hash critical inline styles; drop 'unsafe-inline' from style-src.

description: CSP script hashes are build-time static, not runtime-verified. Supply-chain attack swapping a script between build and runtime would not be detected. Per-request nonce is live control.
recommended_fix: Add runtime canary that hashes one served script per deploy and alerts on mismatch.

description: No courier inbound webhook endpoint. glob /api/courier/ = 0. Courier clients outbound-only. Operational gap (no auto-delivery confirmation) + security gap (when added without HMAC, K-35 forged callbacks possible).
recommended_fix: When adding courier webhooks, include HMAC + replay guard from day one.

description: payment_events dedup constraint is wrong shape: UNIQUE(invoice_id, event_type, status) not V8's UNIQUE(provider, provider_event_id). Partially protective but collapses on body tweaks changing event-id hash fallback.
recommended_fix: Part of INV-2 migration: add provider, provider_event_id columns + UNIQUE(provider, provider_event_id).

description: Raw console.error(err) not routed through safeLog. safeLog is sanctioned logger but unenforced (no ESLint rule). Client-side console.* in islands lower severity.
recommended_fix: Add ESLint no-console rule outside src/lib/pii-scrubber.ts; route RootLayout.astro error through safeLog.

description: assets.run_worker_first excludes customer routes - only /staff/* and /api/* routed through Worker first. Customer .astro pages served directly from asset bundle. Future customer route shadowed by same-path static asset could bypass middleware. No current exploitation.
recommended_fix: Document exclusion contract; ensure no customer .astro route is ever shadowed by same-path static asset.

description: Migration head 0047 vs V8 plan head 0039. Repo migrations 0040-0047 occupy V8 plan's reserved range. V8 schema work (payment_transactions, customer_ref, checkout_id, tax_rates, DO snapshot) cannot land at planned numbers; must renumber to 0048+. Structurally blocks all INV fixes.
recommended_fix: Owner decision: renumber V8 schema migrations to 0048+; update V8_MIGRATION_PLAN.

description: Three queues (order-emails, image-processing, cart-activity) have no DLQ. Exhausted-retry messages silently dropped.
recommended_fix: Add DLQs for all three; wire consumers + drainers + alerts.

description: V8 mandates 31 mandatory tests (not 30 per audit prompt). Of these 31, only 1 exists by canonical name (cart-do-alarm-handoff). Prompt KPI count also off by one.
recommended_fix: Update audit prompt; write the missing 30 tests.

description: Expansion of K-10/K-11: brute-force coupon codes with crafted subtotalPaisa values to enumerate valid coupons + discount curves. Response leaks discountType, discountAmountPaisa, discountPercent.
recommended_fix: Rate-limit by IP + cart sid; recompute subtotal server-side; return only discountPaisa.

description: Cart cookie SameSite=Lax not Strict. CSRF cookies are Strict. Cross-site top-level navigation can carry cart cookie - widens attack surface combined with K-18 + K-39.
recommended_fix: SameSite=Strict (or Lax + HMAC sign the sid).

description: Unauthenticated POST writes to Analytics Engine. No rate-limit. Malicious client can pollute web_vital dataset with garbage strings; Analytics Engine ingestion not free.
recommended_fix: Add middleware rate-limit; validate name/rating against allowlist.

description: EMAIL_TEMPLATES bucket name zabir-email-templates-prod vs V8 6.5 bare zabir-email-templates. Staging/dev use consistent -staging/-dev; prod breaks convention.
recommended_fix: Align on one convention (either bare prod + suffixed non-prod, or suffixed everywhere).

description: No concurrent-execution protection on cron jobs observed. Cloudflare can invoke scheduled concurrently in rare cases. Without claim lock, two concurrent partial-prepay sweeps or abandoned-cart scans could double-process.
recommended_fix: Wrap each cron handler in CronLockDO claim or INSERT INTO cron_claims IF NOT EXISTS.
